# Vicki Collins Acupuncture & Chinese Herbal Medicine

> Registered acupuncturist and Chinese herbal medicine practitioner in Machans
> Beach, Cairns, Queensland, Australia. Over 15 years' experience, specialising
> in fertility and women's health.

## Practitioner

Vicki Collins — Bachelor of Health Science (Acupuncture), distinction, 2003.
AHPRA registered for Chinese Herbal Medicine & Acupuncture. Member of the
Australian Acupuncture Association (AACMA) and registered with the Chinese
Medical Board of Australia (CMBA)/AHPRA.

## Services

- Acupuncture (fine sterilised needles; may be combined with other techniques)
- Fertility acupuncture and IVF/IUI cycle support
- Women's health: menstrual health, pregnancy support, menopause
- Chinese herbal medicine (individually formulated powdered herbal formulas)
- Moxibustion (warming therapy using mugwort)
- Cupping
- Therapeutic massage
- Diet therapy
- Electro acupuncture

## Pricing (as listed on the site)

Initial consultation $80; subsequent treatments $70–$80.
Chinese Herbal consultation $50 (herb costs extra).
Listed practitioner for all major Australian health funds (Chinese herbs not claimable).

## Location & hours

Tuesday–Saturday, 8:00am–6:00pm

## Notes

Content is general information, not medical advice. As an AHPRA member the
practitioner notes that evidence for some acupuncture applications is
